title: Machado Holds First Mass Rally Since Return, Pledges Transition 'Without Vengeance'
detail: María Corina Machado addressed thousands of students at the Universidad Central de Venezuela in Caracas on Nov 25, her first mass public act since returning from a ten-month exile. She promised 'truth without resentment, justice without vengeance', pressed the US-backed interim government of Delcy Rodríguez to set an election date (her camp wants 2027) and called a national neighborhood consultation, with results to be posted on the Punto de Acuerdo platform.
